heroHeadline: Fukushima Daiichi: Unit 1 Rubble Removal and Unit 2 Defueling Begin as ALPS Discharge Reaches 21st Round
heroSubtitle: TEPCO began full-scale rubble removal from Unit 1's reactor building (June 22) and started transferring Unit 2's 615 spent fuel assemblies out of its storage pool (June 2) — two milestones toward eventual fuel debris retrieval. ALPS-treated water discharge continued through its 20th and into its 21st round (begun July 6), briefly and automatically suspended June 13 after a lightning-related power blip with no off-spec release. IAEA Director General Grossi joined China, South Korea, and Switzerland in independent seawater sampling near the plant on June 24.
footerNote: Data sourced from TEPCO, Japan NRA, IAEA, NHK, Fukushima Prefecture, UNSCEAR, and peer-reviewed health studies. Last comprehensive update: July 2026.
